subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: For accepted gateway runs whose CLI socket drops before the final frame, should this PR land the focused fresh-session fallback now, or should it be expanded to reattach-first recovery before merge?
rationale: Both paths protect the original session from duplicate transcript turns, but this PR preserves the existing recook fallback behavior and its possible double execution or double delivery, while reattach-first changes CLI streaming/result behavior and is tracked separately.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run fallback boundary for this rare disconnect and merge the narrow fresh-session protection for the original transcript.

options.title: Expand to reattach-first
options.body: Ask the contributor to fold the related reattach-first design into this PR before merge so accepted disconnects prefer the authoritative gateway run result.

options.title: Pause or close this direction
options.body: If duplicate model/tool execution is unacceptable for accepted disconnects, pause this branch until maintainers choose a no-local-rerun design.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run fallback boundary for this rare disconnect and merge the narrow fresh-session protection for the original transcript.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main accepted-run and gateway dedupe paths route most directly through recent `vincentkoc` history in the relevant agent/gateway files.
